meta.name: systematic-debugging
meta.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 遇到报错或测试失败时,按步骤找到真正原因再动手修
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有 bug 或失败的测试,却不知从哪查起
copy.tagline_en: Track down the real cause of an error or failing test before changing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a bug or failing test leaves you unsure where to start

howto.what: 遇到 bug、测试失败或异常时,Claude 会先做根因调查再动手改,而不是直接猜着修。它按四个阶段推进:根因调查、模式对比、提出并最小化验证假设、实施修复。同一问题改了 3 次还不好,它会停下来质疑架构。
howto.when: 当你遇到 bug、测试失败或意外行为,且在提出修复之前。原文强调时间紧迫、问题看似简单、已试过多次修复时尤其要用。

say.text: 先别改,帮我查清这个 bug 的根因
say.note: 它会先进入根因调查阶段。

say.text: 这个测试挂了,按四阶段流程排查
say.note: 从读报错、复现开始逐阶段推进。

say.text: 我已经改了 3 次都没好,接下来怎么办
say.note: 它会停下质疑架构,而不是再试一次。

howto.what_en: When a bug appears, Claude investigates root cause before proposing any fix instead of guessing. Four phases: root cause, pattern analysis, hypothesis testing, implementation. After 3 failed fixes it questions the architecture.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before fixes are proposed. The doc says to especially use it under time pressure, when the fix looks obvious, or after failed attempts.

say_en.text: Don't fix yet - find the root cause of this bug
say_en.note: It starts root cause investigation first.

say_en.text: This test fails; walk the four phases
say_en.note: Begins by reading errors and reproducing.

say_en.text: I've tried 3 fixes already - now what?
say_en.note: It stops to question the architecture.
